specification.negative_prompt: text, watermark, blurry, flickering, distorted objects
specification.prompt: The camera slowly moves to the right around a red ceramic teapot and green pears on a wooden table, gentle natural window light, coherent still life, smooth subtle camera motion.

upstream_workflow.changes: Pinned model/input hashes, neutral prompt, 640x640, 33 frames, two explicit seeds, MP4/H.264 and video output contract; sampler and shift follow upstream.

limits: Two short silent clips with one model; not arbitrary video model or LoRA compatibility.
No audio synchronization, long clips, cross-runtime pixel determinism, or human aesthetic acceptance.
GPU samples are whole-device observed lower bounds; no calibrated memory predictor or concurrency acceptance.

prepared.limits: No catalog import, seed reservation, or runtime submission.
